name: One Galle Face Mall
description: Sri Lanka's largest international shopping mall, featuring 7 floors of premier global fashion brands, fine dining, a luxury cinema complex, and entertainment centers.

name: Thilakawardhana Textiles
description: One of Sri Lanka's largest and most famous textile and department store chains, offering massive multi-story showrooms for family apparel, footwear, and accessories.

name: Kalutara Town Promenade & Arcade
description: A bustling coastal commercial hub featuring traditional handloom shops, basketry craft centers, and modern clothing outlets near the Kalu Ganga river.

name: Kandy City Centre (KCC)
description: The premier commercial and shopping complex in Kandy, featuring modern amenities, international brands, a food court, and entertainment venues.

name: Matale Heritage & Spice Street Market
description: A vibrant central bazaar famous for spice trading, traditional textile boutiques, and artisan brassware shops in the heart of Matale city.

name: Grand Hotel Shopping Arcade
description: An elegant colonial-style shopping arcade offering Ceylon tea boutiques, winter clothing outlets, and artisanal souvenir shops in 'Little England'.

name: Dutch Hospital Shopping Precinct
description: A restored colonial landmark inside Galle Fort converted into a trendy open-air precinct featuring boutique clothing stores, jewelers, and seaside dining.

name: Matara Dutch Market & Promenade
description: A bustling southern retail zone combining historic colonial structures with lively textile markets, electronics stores, and oceanfront shopping plazas.

name: Tangalle City Plaza & Market
description: A prominent coastal town commercial hub in Hambantota district offering local handicraft stalls, clothing outlets, and fresh seaside bazaars.

name: Cargills Square
description: A modern commercial shopping arcade located in northern Sri Lanka, featuring clothing boutiques, electronic outlets, a food court, and a 3D movie theater.

name: Kilinochchi Central Town Complex
description: The main economic center of Kilinochchi district, featuring newly developed commercial plazas, textile centers, and local agricultural trade hubs.

name: Mannar Main Street Bazaar
description: A historic island town market square known for traditional palmyra handicrafts, dried fish markets, and coastal retail shops.

name: Mullaitivu Coastal Town Center
description: A rapidly developing coastal commercial zone featuring local retail stores, seafood markets, and traditional textile shops along the main thoroughfare.

name: Vavuniya Commercial Plaza
description: A key transit and trading city connecting the Northern and North Central provinces, packed with textile stores, jewelry shops, and busy street markets.

name: Trincomalee Dutch Bay Promenade & Bazaar
description: A vibrant eastern harbor town market area featuring beachside craft stalls, textile outlets, seafood markets, and local retail centers.

name: Batticaloa Gate & Kallady Shopping Hub
description: A scenic lagoon-side commercial zone offering traditional handloom weaving outlets, modern fashion shops, and cultural craft centers.

name: Kalmunai Commercial Center
description: The major economic and retail hub of Ampara district, famous for extensive clothing centers, wholesale markets, and vibrant street shopping.

name: Central Mall Kurunegala
description: A major multi-story commercial complex situated under the shadow of Elephant Rock, featuring prominent fashion stores, supermarkets, and electronics shops.

name: Chilaw Town Bazaar
description: A bustling northwestern coastal commercial center offering fish markets, traditional textile outlets, and jewelry stores.

name: Anuradhapura New Town Arcade
description: The modern commercial core of the ancient capital, offering multi-level clothing department stores, banks, tea shops, and souvenir outlets.

name: Kaduruwela Commercial Center
description: The primary economic and shopping hub of Polonnaruwa district, featuring busy retail streets, textile shops, and agricultural trade complexes.

name: Ella Main Street Promenade
description: A highly popular tourist strip in the hill country lined with eco-boutiques, handmade clothing stores, souvenir shops, and vibrant mountain cafes.

name: Monaragala Central Plaza
description: The main trade center in Uva province, featuring traditional markets, clothing stores, and local handicraft shops serving the surrounding region.

name: Ratnapura Gem Market & City Center
description: World-famous 'City of Gems' commercial district, featuring open-air street markets where precious sapphires are traded daily alongside fashion boutiques.

name: Mawanella Spice & Handloom Arcade
description: A prominent highway town shopping zone known for traditional spice markets, handloom textile outlets, and local pottery workshops.
